bosses.name: Mourning Aix
mechanics: Its Vibration Strength Reduction Rate is lowered by 15 %: parries carry the stagger work.
Counterattacks cut its Vibration Strength by 30 % of max and restore 10 Resonance Energy.
bosses.round2: ATK +6 % every 5 s, up to +72 %; immobilising it clears the stacks.

bosses.name: Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis
mechanics: Dodge Counters cut its Vibration Strength by 20 % of max and restore 10 Resonance Energy.
bosses.round2: The Vibration Strength Reduction it takes is reduced by 20 %.

bosses.name: Sentry Construct
mechanics: Takes 25 % less Vibration Strength Reduction and deals 30 % more DMG while airborne — ground it on the first parry, about 5 s in.
Negative Statuses or Tunability-Shifting raise your Vibration Strength Reduction Rate by 50 %.
bosses.round2: ATK +3 % every 5 s, stacking 10 times; immobilising it clears the stacks.

bosses.name: Tempest Mephis
mechanics: Counterattacks raise its Off-Tune Level by 20 % of max and cut its Vibration Strength by 30 % of max.
Nearly every attack has a counterattack window.
bosses.round2: +30 % ATK, disabled while under Tune Strain (Shifting or Interfered) — a Tune Strain team shuts it off.

bosses.name: Matrix Mimic
mechanics: Singularity Expansion only. Equal RES to every attribute.
Damage dealt to it yields 1.1× points; after the kill the next team gets 15 s of damage and interrupt immunity.

circuits.name: General Enhancement
circuits.effect: Enemies take 20 % more total DMG and 20 % more total Heavy Attack DMG.

circuits.name: Enhancement: Negative Status
circuits.effect: Under a Negative Status the target takes 25 % more total DMG for 30 s. Enemies take 80 % more total Glacio Chafe DMG.

circuits.name: Enhancement: Echo Skill
circuits.effect: +30 % total Echo Skill DMG, +20 % total Havoc DMG, +20 % total Resonance Skill DMG.

circuits.name: Enhancement: Tune Break
circuits.effect: Tunability-Shifting inflicted: the team deals 25 % more total DMG for 30 s. Tune Strain-Shifting inflicted: that Resonator deals 30 % more for 15 s.
